evidence.note: A training-free controller for parallel reasoning that probes each branch every 500 tokens for a tentative answer distribution, averages recent probes into a 'temporal confidence' score, and uses that one signal to prune, retire, fork and globally stop branches.
evidence.title: ParaTempo: Efficient Parallel Reasoning via Temporal Confidence

evidence.note: FROST uses attention weights to identify and prune sentence-level 'reasoning outliers' from a reasoning model's chain of thought, reporting an average 69.68% token reduction and 26.70% accuracy gain over the base model on four maths benchmarks.
evidence.title: FROST: Filtering Reasoning Outliers with Attention for Efficient Reasoning
